MARIOLA

Spanish film, television and theatre actress working in Spanish and English, based in Madrid and Barcelona. Playing age 26–31. As an EU citizen I’m free to work anywhere in the European Union, and I’m available for productions across Europe and the UK, self-tapes and travel. I trained for four years at Estudio Corazza in Madrid (2020–2024) and keep training alongside my work. I’m very sporty and happiest outdoors – in the mountains or by the water, whenever I get the chance.
